themes.name: daily aktivity
themes.prompt: You are editing a photobooth collage. Image 1 is the BASE TEMPLATE (the white vintage handheld game console collage with 'Sundate time' and 'Yujinie' text). The following images are user photos: Image 2, Image 3, Image 4, Image 5. CRITICAL - KEEP THE BASE TEMPLATE EXACTLY: Do NOT change the layout, orientation, aspect ratio, or composition of Image 1. Keep it in the SAME vertical portrait orientation. Keep ALL decorations, text ('Sundate time', 'Yujinie', 'You get all my attention', 'cutie', 'no one heard a thing', 'Pretty Yujinie'), stickers (headphones, stars, pink hearts, candy, milk carton, fried egg, rubber duck, music notes, coffee cup, white ribbon), the game console graphic, and all frame positions EXACTLY where they are. EXACT PHOTO PLACEMENT - replace ONLY the people, keep frames in place: 1) The large cutout person on the LEFT side (outside the frames, standing on the console) - replace that person with the person from Image 2. 2) The TOP framed photo - replace with the person from Image 3. 3) The MIDDLE framed photo - replace with the person from Image 4. 4) The BOTTOM framed photo - replace with the person from Image 5. STYLE MATCHING: Edit each user photo to match the visual style, color grading, lighting, and warm aesthetic of the original photos in the base template. The user photos must blend seamlessly and look like they belong in this collage. KEEP REALISTIC: All people must remain REALISTIC photographs - do NOT convert them to cartoon, anime, or illustration. Maintain their real faces and identities. Only the people inside/on the frames change - everything else in the template stays identical.
